entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:14025
Court No. - 27
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1235 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohammad Taj Waris And 5 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Shahid Raza Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Shahid Raza, the learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Anurag Verma, the learned A.G.A.-I appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. By means of the instant application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants have sought quashing of charge sheet along with cognizance order dated 07.11.2022, and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.100861 of 2021: State Vs. Taj Waris, arising out of Case Crime No.363 of 2021,
under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow, pending in the Court of Special A.C.J.M. (C.B.I.-A.P.), Lucknow on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
3. The original compromise dated 10.07.2023 is annexed with the application wherein it is recorded that the parties belong to the same family and they have resolved their disputes amicably.

The proceedings of charge sheet along with cognizance order dated 07.11.2022 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.100861 of 2021: State Vs.
Taj Waris, arising out of Case Crime No.363 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow

, pending in the Court of Special A.C.J.M. (C.B.I.-A.P.), Lucknow are hereby quashed.
.
